content: 1[378ZF.Internal audit.-- Every Producer Company shall have internal audit of its accounts carried out, at such interval and in such manner as may be specified in articles, by a chartered accountant as defined in clause (b) of sub-section (1) of section 2 of the Chartered Accountants Act, 1949 (38 of 1949).]
footnote: </br><hr style="border-top:1px solid #0778be"/>1. Ins. by Act 29 of 2020, s. 52 (w.e.f. 11-2-2021).</br><hr style="border-top:1px solid #0778be"/>
